source.kind: generic rewrite inspired by a private short-reply pattern and comparative verdicts
source.note: Source labels identify private evidence without exposing local account paths. Originals were read and left unchanged. No personal source text or raw logs are shipped.

license.licensed_work: The complete short-answers bundle, including this derivation record; external dependencies retain their own licences.
license.note: Uses the repository licence bytes unchanged. Prepared for review; merging and catalog publication require maintainer approval.

hash_scope: copy_files lists every shipped file except DERIVATION.json, which cannot contain its own hash. Rollups are SHA-256 of path:sha256 lines in path order, each terminated by a newline. source_files describes historical private originals, not published copies.

edits.why: New generic wording: outcome first, at most five short lines, one ask at a time, no jargon. Explicitly requested detail and required formats take precedence. Removed recipient identity, personal quotes, examples, company details and private approval rules; brevity does not grant authority to act.
Added source verdict scope and limits; no measured benefit is asserted for the rewritten skill.
